prompt: A high school has $1{,}200$ students. The student council surveys $100$ of them about a later start time. What is the POPULATION in this study?

choices.label: The students who want a later start time
The members of the student council

hint: The population is the WHOLE group you want to learn about. The sample is the part you actually ask.

hints.text: The population is the WHOLE group you want to learn about. The sample is the part you actually ask.
The council wants to know what the school thinks, not just what 100 students think.
The population is all $1{,}200$ students: choice B. The $100$ surveyed are the sample.

explanation: The council wants to draw a conclusion about the entire school.
So the population is every student, all $1{,}200$ of them.
The $100$ students surveyed are the sample, a part of the population used to learn about the whole. Choice B.

alternativeExplanations.title: Ask "about whom?"
steps: The question the council really wants answered is "Do OUR STUDENTS want a later start?"
Whoever "our students" refers to is the population: all 1,200.
Anything smaller that is actually measured is a sample.
